study: E1/E3/E4 MPS follow-up after full E2
epoch_rule: Each model/strategy independently: seed42 clean inner validation; best epoch>=30; delta .001 patience20 no_defense,30 defenses counted after30; cap150. Final fits full855 for selected fixed epoch. No outer test selection.
regularization: Use E2 lr/dropout/wd for model; E1 all family inherit Yu3. S4/regularization/combined wd=max(E2wd,1e-4), others E2wd. This transparent strategy override is common within family; E2 already selecting wd may make regularization contrast redundant for some baselines.
reconstruction: RecAux one-channel M1 encoder, same decoder as Yu3; CE+.5MSE to actual training image (including augmentation). Yu3 .5CE1+CE2+.5MSE, detached absolute residual, original shared BN.
sensitivity: ZeroFB/ShuffleFB retain two passes, same loss, decoder, two-channel encoder and BN; shuffle uses cyclic replacement in fixed 32-sample minibatches. Not a causal decomposition; extra controls exploratory.
folds: New reproducible 5-fold class-pure device-group assignment, per-class shuffled tie order seed42 then size-descending greedy smallest class count. Original fold manifest unavailable: do not claim historical fold reproduction. Every fold normalization fit its own training indices only.
strategy_selection: Exact fold noise ties each get a win; maximize noise wins then mean five-fold severe-condition F1; retain all exact final ties. Missing: strict wins over same-fold No-Defense, maximize min-win then total-win, retain all ties. All co-selected strategies trained and evaluated; all selected pair combinations included in the E3 Holm family. No outer-test selection.
schedule: E1 pilots+180 final fits incl60 sensitivity; E3 120 fold fits + selected pilots/final fits; outer evaluation only after ALL epoch and strategy selection. Baselines also common S3/combined for supplement; Yu3-selected new strategies propagated to family.
contamination: Outer219 previously viewed in older experiments; no outer outcomes accessed by this new selection queue. New environment not historical numerical reproduction.
augmentation: Existing supplied default p=.5, equiprobable types and uniform original severities1-20%; historical default fidelity unconfirmed. New30-50% consecutive missing evaluated only, never trained.
primary_tests: Two-sided exact signed-rank permutation, train seed paired n10, ten pollution seeds averaged first. E1 four contrasts Yu3-RecAux,Yu3-M1,RecAux-M1,M3-M1, 3 common strategies, clean F1 + full severity F1/Dabs; single Holm across all prespecified common-strategy tests. E3 separate Holm over Yu3-three-baselines, all matched track conditions+NoDefense clean. Sensitivity controls descriptive. Bootstrap paired mean CI seed20261106,10000 draws; rank-biserial effects.
relative_ce: From original Word math: sum_s[(1-F1_s)-(1-F1_clean)] / same M1 sum, per train seed, F1 fractions. Native levels and extended consecutive grid separate. Denominator <=1e-6 flagged (raw ratio retained unless |denominator|<=1e-6); stable aggregate excludes flagged, random CE un-interpreted; mCE requires all three noise/SP/consecutive valid.

selection_rule_amendment.reason: Restore original supplied Stage1 missing-data selection definition; v1 mistakenly counted per-fold first place rather than beating No-Defense. Also restore original noise majority-tie mean-score rule.
selection_rule_amendment.observed_before_correction: Yu3 and ResNet18 completed inner-fold scores were already available; MobileNetV3 fold0 S4 paused at saved epoch83. No current outer-test evaluations or selected-strategy final fits had occurred.
selection_rule_amendment.disclosure: Bug correction after inner-validation outcomes were available; not described as a pristine preregistration or a test-driven strategy change.

tie_rule_amendment.authorized_by: Author explicitly approved retaining all exact ties in this chat on 2026-11-07, after viewing partial inner results.
tie_rule_amendment.rules: Noise: all exactly equal within-fold leaders get a win, then maximize five-fold wins and mean severe-score, retaining exact final ties. Missing: strictly beat same-fold No-Defense, maximize min-win then total-win, retain all exact ties. No listed-order tie-break. Exact equality, no tolerance.
tie_rule_amendment.evaluation: Train/evaluate every co-selected strategy. All unique Yu3-baseline strategy pair combinations enter same E3 Holm family. Never select by outer-test outcomes.
tie_rule_amendment.disclosure: Prospective for current outer test; post hoc to observed partial inner validation. Not pristine preregistration. Training, data, seeds, folds, epochs and pollution levels unchanged.
